reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 ADOMI GAMES，发行商同名）与英文讨论区首页（可见 2 个主题，总数 2），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 3 次、登记的为其中 1 次、共 6 条结果，读取 0 篇原始来源（三次检索只返回本作的多语言商店页、google.com/goto 跳转壳以及与其他作品有关的 AI 争议内容，没有出现针对本作的独立报道）。缺少可读报道只说明检索范围，不作为判定依据。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。 本作核查时尚未发售（商店页标注 Coming soon）。披露笼统写作“视觉与游戏内素材”，未细分音乐、语音或文本，相应领域按“披露未说明”处理。
disclosureQuote: Generative AI was used during development to create some visual and in-game assets. No content is generated by AI during gameplay.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-10-31 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: An online life simulation for up to 6 players. The developer states that generative AI was used during development to create some visual and in-game assets, and that no content is generated by AI during gameplay.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer ADOMI GAMES, self-published) and the English discussion homepage (2 visible topics of 2); no topic concerns AI use beyond the disclosure itself and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 3 times; the logged search has 6 results and 0 raw source(s) were read, because the searches returned only localised store pages for this title, google.com/goto redirect shells and AI controversies about other games, with no independent coverage of this title. Unreadable coverage only describes the search scope and is not treated as a finding. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit. The game had not been released at review time (the store page lists Coming soon). The disclosure names visual and in-game assets generally and does not break them down into art, music, voice or text, so those areas stay recorded as not addressed.
